infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Bee Voice+ uses the microphone only while you hold Talk or when you enable the optional on-device wake word.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Bee Voice+ can use the operating system's on-device speech recognizer for the optional wake word. Audio is not sent to the Voice+ server for wake-word detection.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Bee Voice+ to use the microphone for push-to-talk and the optional on-device wake word.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Bee Voice+ to use the operating system speech recognizer for the optional on-device wake word.
